title: 柏崎刈羽 6、7 號 ABWR 機組
subcategoryTitle: 沸水式、重水式與氣冷式機組
summary: 柏崎刈羽 6、7 號機是全球最早商轉的 ABWR，所在電廠七部機組合計 8,212 MW 為世界最大；課程定量分析內置式再循環泵、電動微調控制棒驅動機構、鋼筋混凝土圍阻體，以及 2007 年中越沖地震中實測加速度超過設計值的評估與補強。
summaryEn: Kashiwazaki-Kariwa 6 and 7 were the first ABWRs in commercial operation, on a site whose seven units total 8,212 MW, the largest in the world; the course quantifies reactor internal pumps, electric fine-motion control-rod drives, the reinforced-concrete containment, and evaluation and strengthening after measured accelerations exceeded design values in the 2007 Chūetsu offshore earthquake.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 首批進步型沸水式機組：內置再循環泵、微調控制棒驅動與 2007 年地震的教訓
v30FocusEn: The first advanced boiling-water reactors: internal pumps, fine-motion control-rod drives and lessons of the 2007 earthquake

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：柏崎刈羽 6、7 號 ABWR 機組
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Kashiwazaki-Kariwa Units 6 and 7 ABWR
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「年發電量與容量因數」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Annual energy and capacity factor": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" is correct?
options: 核電廠先把反應爐的熱功率轉成蒸汽，再由汽輪發電機轉成電力；電功率與熱功率的比值就是電廠熱效率。
核電廠效率比火力電廠低，表示有三分之二的燃料被浪費掉。
機組裝置容量越大，每年發的電就一定越多。
optionsEn: A nuclear plant first turns reactor thermal power into steam and then into electricity in the turbine generator.
Nuclear plants are less efficient than fossil plants, meaning two thirds of the fuel is wasted.
The larger the installed capacity of a unit, the more energy it must produce each year.
quiz.explanation: 核電廠先把反應爐的熱功率轉成蒸汽，再由汽輪發電機轉成電力；電功率與熱功率的比值就是電廠熱效率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A nuclear plant first turns reactor thermal power into steam and then into electricity in the turbine generator; the ratio of electrical to thermal power is plant thermal efficiency. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 熱功率、電功率與淨效率：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」如何決定「柏崎刈羽 6、7 號 ABWR 機組」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Kashiwazaki-Kariwa Units 6 and 7 ABWR”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 核電廠先把反應爐的熱功率轉成蒸汽，再由汽輪發電機轉成電力；電功率與熱功率的比值就是電廠熱效率。輕水式機組受限於約 280 至 290 °C 的飽和蒸汽溫度，淨效率約 33% 至 37%，其餘近三分之二的熱量必須經凝汽器排到海水、河水或冷卻塔。以「柏崎刈羽 6、7 號 ABWR 機組」為例，熱功率決定了爐心、蒸汽供應系統與安全系統的規模，電功率則決定汽輪機、發電機與輸電設備。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A nuclear plant first turns reactor thermal power into steam and then into electricity in the turbine generator; the ratio of electrical to thermal power is plant thermal efficiency. Light-water units are limited by saturated steam at about 280–290 °C, giving 33–37% net efficiency, so nearly two thirds of the heat must be rejected through the condenser to sea, river or cooling towers. For Kashiwazaki-Kariwa Units 6 and 7 ABWR, thermal power sizes the core, steam supply and safety systems, while electrical power sizes turbine, generator and transmission. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：6、7 號機各為 1,356 MW（毛出力），熱功率 3,926 MW
steps.observationEn: Project file: Units 6 and 7 are each 1,356 MW gross with 3,926 MW thermal
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「核電廠效率比火力電廠低，表示有三分之二的燃料被浪費掉。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Nuclear plants are less efficient than fossil plants, meaning two thirds of the fuel is wasted." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 熱功率、電功率與淨效率
knowledge.titleEn: Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency
knowledge.text: 核電廠先把反應爐的熱功率轉成蒸汽，再由汽輪發電機轉成電力；電功率與熱功率的比值就是電廠熱效率。輕水式機組受限於約 280 至 290 °C 的飽和蒸汽溫度，淨效率約 33% 至 37%，其餘近三分之二的熱量必須經凝汽器排到海水、河水或冷卻塔。以「柏崎刈羽 6、7 號 ABWR 機組」為例，熱功率決定了爐心、蒸汽供應系統與安全系統的規模，電功率則決定汽輪機、發電機與輸電設備。
knowledge.textEn: A nuclear plant first turns reactor thermal power into steam and then into electricity in the turbine generator; the ratio of electrical to thermal power is plant thermal efficiency. Light-water units are limited by saturated steam at about 280–290 °C, giving 33–37% net efficiency, so nearly two thirds of the heat must be rejected through the condenser to sea, river or cooling towers. For Kashiwazaki-Kariwa Units 6 and 7 ABWR, thermal power sizes the core, steam supply and safety systems, while electrical power sizes turbine, generator and transmission.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：核電廠效率比火力電廠低，表示有三分之二的燃料被浪費掉。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Nuclear plants are less efficient than fossil plants, meaning two thirds of the fuel is wasted. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 6、7 號機各為 1,356 MW（毛出力），熱功率 3,926 MW
knowledge.textEn: Units 6 and 7 are each 1,356 MW gross with 3,926 MW thermal

quiz.question: 依「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的模型 η = P_e / P_th，淨電功率與爐心熱功率之比最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model η = P_e / P_th for "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency", which value is closest to the ratio of net electrical power to core thermal power?
quiz.explanation: η = P_e / P_th；代入 Pe = 1315 MW、Pth = 3926 MW，得 33.5 %（淨電功率與爐心熱功率之比）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: η = P_e / P_th; with Pe = 1315 MW, Pth = 3926 MW the result is 33.5 % (ratio of net electrical power to core thermal power). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 熱功率、電功率與淨效率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：η = P_e / P_th；代入 Pe = 1315 MW、Pth = 3926 MW，得 33.5 %（淨電功率與爐心熱功率之比）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 Pe 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: η = P_e / P_th; with Pe = 1315 MW, Pth = 3926 MW the result is 33.5 % (ratio of net electrical power to core thermal power). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise Pe by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：Pe 增加 10% 時，結果變為 36.8 %（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising Pe by 10% changes the result to 36.8 % (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 33.5 %（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 Pe 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 33.5 % (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in Pe with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: η = P_e / P_th；代入 Pe = 1315 MW、Pth = 3926 MW，得 33.5 %（淨電功率與爐心熱功率之比）。
knowledge.textEn: η = P_e / P_th; with Pe = 1315 MW, Pth = 3926 MW the result is 33.5 % (ratio of net electrical power to core thermal power).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: Pe 增加 10% 時，結果變為 36.8 %（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising Pe by 10% changes the result to 36.8 % (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
圍阻體的作用只是防止飛機撞擊。
以熱平衡試驗核對：用校正過的飼水流量計、溫度與壓力量測計算蒸汽產生器或爐心的熱功率，同時以關口電表量測淨輸出，換算到設計冷卻水溫後與保證熱耗率比較。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The only purpose of a containment is to stop aircraft impact.

Check by heat-balance test: compute steam-generator or core thermal power from calibrated feedwater flow, temperature and pressure, measure net output at the revenue meter, correct to design cooling-water temperature and compare with the guaranteed heat rate.
quiz.explanation: 以熱平衡試驗核對：用校正過的飼水流量計、溫度與壓力量測計算蒸汽產生器或爐心的熱功率，同時以關口電表量測淨輸出，換算到設計冷卻水溫後與保證熱耗率比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check by heat-balance test: compute steam-generator or core thermal power from calibrated feedwater flow, temperature and pressure, measure net output at the revenue meter, correct to design cooling-water temperature and compare with the guaranteed heat rate. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 熱功率、電功率與淨效率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以熱平衡試驗核對：用校正過的飼水流量計、溫度與壓力量測計算蒸汽產生器或爐心的熱功率，同時以關口電表量測淨輸出，換算到設計冷卻水溫後與保證熱耗率比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check by heat-balance test: compute steam-generator or core thermal power from calibrated feedwater flow, temperature and pressure, measure net output at the revenue meter, correct to design cooling-water temperature and compare with the guaranteed heat rate. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：熱功率計算的每一個輸入儀器都要有校正追溯與不確定度評估，並定期以獨立方法（例如超音波流量計）交叉比對。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Every instrument feeding the thermal-power calculation needs traceable calibration and an uncertainty assessment, with periodic cross-checks by an independent method such as ultrasonic flow measurement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：飼水流量計的文氏管結垢會使量測值偏高、計算出的熱功率偏高，電廠為了不超過執照熱功率而實際降載，表現為「效率莫名下降」。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Fouling of a feedwater venturi biases flow high, so calculated thermal power reads high and the plant effectively runs below licensed power to stay within the limit, appearing as an unexplained efficiency loss. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以熱平衡試驗核對：用校正過的飼水流量計、溫度與壓力量測計算蒸汽產生器或爐心的熱功率，同時以關口電表量測淨輸出，換算到設計冷卻水溫後與保證熱耗率比較。
knowledge.textEn: Check by heat-balance test: compute steam-generator or core thermal power from calibrated feedwater flow, temperature and pressure, measure net output at the revenue meter, correct to design cooling-water temperature and compare with the guaranteed heat rate.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 熱功率計算的每一個輸入儀器都要有校正追溯與不確定度評估，並定期以獨立方法（例如超音波流量計）交叉比對。
knowledge.textEn: Every instrument feeding the thermal-power calculation needs traceable calibration and an uncertainty assessment, with periodic cross-checks by an independent method such as ultrasonic flow measurement.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IAEA SSR-2/1 核電廠安全：設計。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IAEA SSR-2/1 Safety of Nuclear Power Plants: Design. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 飼水流量計的文氏管結垢會使量測值偏高、計算出的熱功率偏高，電廠為了不超過執照熱功率而實際降載，表現為「效率莫名下降」。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
機組裝置容量越大，每年發的電就一定越多。
optionsEn: Fouling of a feedwater venturi biases flow high, so calculated thermal power reads high and the plant effectively runs below licensed power to stay within the limit, appearing as an unexplained efficiency loss.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
The larger the installed capacity of a unit, the more energy it must produce each year.
quiz.explanation: 飼水流量計的文氏管結垢會使量測值偏高、計算出的熱功率偏高，電廠為了不超過執照熱功率而實際降載，表現為「效率莫名下降」。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Fouling of a feedwater venturi biases flow high, so calculated thermal power reads high and the plant effectively runs below licensed power to stay within the limit, appearing as an unexplained efficiency loss. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 熱功率、電功率與淨效率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 飼水流量計的文氏管結垢會使量測值偏高、計算出的熱功率偏高，電廠為了不超過執照熱功率而實際降載，表現為「效率莫名下降」。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「柏崎刈羽 6、7 號 ABWR 機組」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Fouling of a feedwater venturi biases flow high, so calculated thermal power reads high and the plant effectively runs below licensed power to stay within the limit, appearing as an unexplained efficiency loss. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Kashiwazaki-Kariwa Units 6 and 7 ABWR”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以「柏崎刈羽 6、7 號 ABWR 機組」為例，熱功率決定了爐心、蒸汽供應系統與安全系統的規模，電功率則決定汽輪機、發電機與輸電設備。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: For Kashiwazaki-Kariwa Units 6 and 7 ABWR, thermal power sizes the core, steam supply and safety systems, while electrical power sizes turbine, generator and transmission.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「核電廠效率比火力電廠低，表示有三分之二的燃料被浪費掉。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Nuclear plants are less efficient than fossil plants, meaning two thirds of the fuel is wasted." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 飼水流量計的文氏管結垢會使量測值偏高、計算出的熱功率偏高，電廠為了不超過執照熱功率而實際降載，表現為「效率莫名下降」。
knowledge.textEn: Fouling of a feedwater venturi biases flow high, so calculated thermal power reads high and the plant effectively runs below licensed power to stay within the limit, appearing as an unexplained efficiency loss.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 關於「年發電量與容量因數」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Annual energy and capacity factor" is correct?
options: 機組裝置容量越大，每年發的電就一定越多。
把泵裝進壓力槽只是為了節省廠房空間。
核電機組燃料成本低、固定成本高，最經濟的運轉方式是長時間滿載作為基載。
optionsEn: The larger the installed capacity of a unit, the more energy it must produce each year.
Putting the pumps inside the vessel is only to save space in the building.
Nuclear units have low fuel cost and high fixed cost, so they run most economically at full load as baseload.
quiz.explanation: 核電機組燃料成本低、固定成本高，最經濟的運轉方式是長時間滿載作為基載。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Nuclear units have low fuel cost and high fixed cost, so they run most economically at full load as baseload. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 年發電量與容量因數：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Annual energy and capacity factor: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「年發電量與容量因數」如何決定「柏崎刈羽 6、7 號 ABWR 機組」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Annual energy and capacity factor” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Kashiwazaki-Kariwa Units 6 and 7 ABWR”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 核電機組燃料成本低、固定成本高，最經濟的運轉方式是長時間滿載作為基載。容量因數反映一年中實際發電量占滿載發電量的比例，主要損失來自換料大修與非計畫停機；成熟機組可長期維持 90% 左右。評估「柏崎刈羽 6、7 號 ABWR 機組」對電力系統的貢獻時，要同時看裝置容量與容量因數，並留意單一大機組跳機時系統必須準備的備轉容量。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Nuclear units have low fuel cost and high fixed cost, so they run most economically at full load as baseload. Capacity factor is actual annual energy as a share of full-load energy, with losses mainly from refuelling outages and unplanned shutdowns; mature units sustain about 90%. Judging the contribution of Kashiwazaki-Kariwa Units 6 and 7 ABWR to a power system needs both capacity and capacity factor, and attention to the reserve the system must hold for the trip of a single large unit. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：6 號機於 1996 年 11 月、7 號機於 1997 年 7 月商轉
steps.observationEn: Project file: Unit 6 entered commercial operation in November 1996 and unit 7 in July 1997
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「機組裝置容量越大，每年發的電就一定越多。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The larger the installed capacity of a unit, the more energy it must produce each year." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「年發電量與容量因數」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Annual energy and capacity factor”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 依「年發電量與容量因數」的模型 E = P_e·8760·CF，單一機組的年淨發電量最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model E = P_e·8760·CF for "Annual energy and capacity factor", which value is closest to the annual net generation of one unit?
options: 10.4 TWh
104 TWh
5.18 TWh
optionsEn: 10.4 TWh
104 TWh
5.18 TWh
quiz.explanation: E = P_e·8760·CF；代入 Pe = 1315 MW、CF = 0.9，得 10.4 TWh（單一機組的年淨發電量）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: E = P_e·8760·CF; with Pe = 1315 MW, CF = 0.9 the result is 10.4 TWh (annual net generation of one unit). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 年發電量與容量因數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Annual energy and capacity factor: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「年發電量與容量因數」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Annual energy and capacity factor” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：E = P_e·8760·CF；代入 Pe = 1315 MW、CF = 0.9，得 10.4 TWh（單一機組的年淨發電量）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 CF 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: E = P_e·8760·CF; with Pe = 1315 MW, CF = 0.9 the result is 10.4 TWh (annual net generation of one unit). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise CF by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：CF 增加 10% 時，結果變為 11.4 TWh（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising CF by 10% changes the result to 11.4 TWh (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 10.4 TWh（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 CF 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 10.4 TWh (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in CF with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: E = P_e·8760·CF；代入 Pe = 1315 MW、CF = 0.9，得 10.4 TWh（單一機組的年淨發電量）。
knowledge.textEn: E = P_e·8760·CF; with Pe = 1315 MW, CF = 0.9 the result is 10.4 TWh (annual net generation of one unit).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: CF 增加 10% 時，結果變為 11.4 TWh（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising CF by 10% changes the result to 11.4 TWh (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「年發電量與容量因數」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Annual energy and capacity factor"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以國際原子能總署 PRIS 資料庫或業主年報的逐年發電量、可用率與非計畫能力損失率核對，並區分計畫性大修、延長大修與強迫停機的貢獻。
地震超過設計值，設備就一定會損壞。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Check against yearly generation, availability and unplanned capability loss in the IAEA PRIS database or owner reports, separating planned outages, outage extensions and forced outages.
If an earthquake exceeds the design value, equipment is bound to be damaged.
quiz.explanation: 以國際原子能總署 PRIS 資料庫或業主年報的逐年發電量、可用率與非計畫能力損失率核對，並區分計畫性大修、延長大修與強迫停機的貢獻。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check against yearly generation, availability and unplanned capability loss in the IAEA PRIS database or owner reports, separating planned outages, outage extensions and forced outages. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 年發電量與容量因數：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Annual energy and capacity factor: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「年發電量與容量因數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Annual energy and capacity factor” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以國際原子能總署 PRIS 資料庫或業主年報的逐年發電量、可用率與非計畫能力損失率核對，並區分計畫性大修、延長大修與強迫停機的貢獻。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check against yearly generation, availability and unplanned capability loss in the IAEA PRIS database or owner reports, separating planned outages, outage extensions and forced outages. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：大修工期要以關鍵路徑管理，並在大修前完成長交期備品與檢測人力的確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Outage duration should be managed on the critical path, with long-lead spares and inspection staff confirmed before the outage starts.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：大修中發現的組件劣化若未事先備料，會使大修延長數週到數月；一再延長的大修是容量因數下滑最常見的原因。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Degradation found during an outage without spares at hand extends it by weeks or months; repeated outage extensions are the commonest cause of falling capacity factor. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
